name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
summary: Direct income support for farmer families who own cultivable land.
benefits: Rs 6,000 per year, paid in three instalments of Rs 2,000 directly into the bank account.
eligibility: Landholding farmer families with cultivable land in their name. Income tax payers, government employees and certain professionals are excluded.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
summary: Free cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals for eligible poor and vulnerable families, and for all citizens aged 70 and above.
benefits: Health cover of up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year for hospital admission at empanelled government and private hospitals.
eligibility: Families listed under the SECC 2011 deprivation criteria and state-added beneficiary lists. All citizens aged 70+ are covered regardless of income.

name: PM Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
summary: Financial help to build a pucca house for rural families who are homeless or live in kutcha houses.
benefits: Rs 1.2 lakh in plain areas and Rs 1.3 lakh in hilly and difficult areas for house construction, plus support for a toilet through other schemes.
eligibility: Rural households that are homeless or live in kutcha or dilapidated houses, selected through SECC data and Awaas+ survey and verified by the Gram Sabha.
documents: Swachh Bharat Mission number, if any

name: PM Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
summary: Help for urban poor and middle-class families to build, buy or rent an affordable pucca house.
benefits: Central assistance through four routes: build your own house, affordable housing projects, affordable rental housing, and interest subsidy on home loans.
eligibility: Urban EWS, LIG and MIG families who do not own a pucca house anywhere in India.
documents: Aadhaar card of all family members
Self-declaration of not owning a pucca house

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
summary: Free LPG gas connection for women from poor households, so families can cook without smoke.
benefits: Deposit-free LPG connection with first refill and stove support as per current scheme rules.
eligibility: Adult women from poor households (such as SC/ST, PMAY, AAY, forest dwellers, or by self-declaration of poverty) with no existing LPG connection in the household.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Finance
summary: A high-interest savings account for a girl child's education and future.
benefits: Government-backed interest rate (revised every quarter), tax benefit under Section 80C, deposits from Rs 250 to Rs 1.5 lakh per year.
eligibility: Parent or guardian of a girl child below 10 years of age. Account opens at a post office or authorised bank.
documents: Birth certificate of the girl child
Aadhaar and PAN of parent or guardian

name: PM Mudra Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Finance
summary: Collateral-free loans for small non-farm businesses like shops, tailoring, repair work and small manufacturing.
benefits: Loans in categories Shishu (up to Rs 50,000), Kishore (up to Rs 5 lakh), Tarun (up to Rs 10 lakh) and Tarun Plus (up to Rs 20 lakh for those who repaid a Tarun loan).
eligibility: Any Indian citizen with a business plan for a non-farm income-generating micro or small enterprise.

name: Stand-Up India
ministry: Ministry of Finance
summary: Bank loans for women and SC/ST entrepreneurs to start a new business.
benefits: Bank loans between Rs 10 lakh and Rs 1 crore for a new (greenfield) enterprise in manufacturing, services, trading or agri-allied activities.
eligibility: SC/ST and/or women entrepreneurs aged 18+, setting up a first-time enterprise; not a defaulter to any bank.

name: PM SVANidhi
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
summary: Small collateral-free working capital loans for street vendors.
benefits: Working capital loans in increasing amounts on timely repayment, with interest subsidy and cashback on digital payments.
eligibility: Street vendors with a vending certificate or identity card from the urban local body, or a letter of recommendation.
documents: Vending certificate or ID / letter of recommendation

name: PM Vishwakarma
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
summary: Support for traditional artisans and craftspeople in 18 trades such as carpenters, tailors, potters and blacksmiths.
benefits: PM Vishwakarma certificate and ID, skill training with stipend, toolkit incentive of up to Rs 15,000, and collateral-free credit up to Rs 3 lakh at concessional interest.
eligibility: Artisans aged 18+ working with hands and tools in one of the 18 listed family-based trades. One member per family; government employees excluded.

name: Atal Pension Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Finance (PFRDA)
summary: A guaranteed monthly pension after age 60 for workers who save a small amount every month.
benefits: Guaranteed pension of Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000 per month after 60, depending on contribution. Pension continues to spouse, and the corpus goes to the nominee.
eligibility: Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 with a savings bank account. Income tax payers cannot join (since October 2022).

name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
summary: Low-cost life insurance renewed every year through your bank account.
benefits: Life cover of Rs 2 lakh on death due to any reason, for a premium of Rs 436 per year auto-debited from the bank account.
eligibility: People aged 18 to 50 with a savings bank or post office account who give consent for auto-debit.

name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
summary: Accident insurance for just Rs 20 a year.
benefits: Rs 2 lakh for accidental death or total disability, Rs 1 lakh for partial disability, for a premium of Rs 20 per year.
eligibility: People aged 18 to 70 with a savings bank or post office account who give consent for auto-debit.

name: PM Jan Dhan Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Finance
summary: A zero-balance bank account for every household, with a RuPay debit card and built-in accident cover.
benefits: Zero-balance savings account, RuPay debit card with accident insurance cover, and an overdraft facility for eligible account holders. Needed to receive most government cash benefits (DBT).
eligibility: Any Indian citizen aged 10+ without a bank account.
documents: Aadhaar card (or other officially valid document)

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
summary: Easy short-term credit for farming, animal husbandry and fisheries at low interest.
benefits: Flexible crop and working capital loans with interest subvention and extra incentive for prompt repayment.
eligibility: Farmers (owners, tenant farmers, sharecroppers), self-help groups, and people in animal husbandry or fisheries.

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (Crop Insurance)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
summary: Low-premium insurance against crop loss due to natural calamities, pests and disease.
benefits: Farmer premium of 2% for kharif crops, 1.5% for rabi crops and 5% for commercial or horticultural crops; the rest is paid by government.
eligibility: All farmers including tenant farmers and sharecroppers growing notified crops in notified areas.

name: PM Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
summary: Cash support for pregnant women and new mothers to cover wage loss and better nutrition.
benefits: Rs 5,000 for the first child (in instalments) and Rs 6,000 for a second child if it is a girl, paid by DBT.
eligibility: Pregnant women and lactating mothers, excluding those in regular government jobs, subject to scheme eligibility criteria.
documents: Birth registration of child (for later instalments)

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
summary: Cash assistance to pregnant women for giving birth in a government or accredited hospital.
benefits: Cash incentive for institutional delivery; the amount depends on the state and whether you live in a rural or urban area.
eligibility: Pregnant women, with focus on BPL and SC/ST families; all pregnant women in low-performing states.

name: National Scholarship Portal (Central Scholarships)
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and IT (portal) with several ministries
summary: One portal to apply for central pre-matric, post-matric and merit scholarships for SC, ST, OBC, minority and other students.
benefits: Scholarship money for tuition and maintenance, paid directly to the student's bank account. Amount depends on the scheme and course.
eligibility: School and college students who meet the income, category and marks criteria of the specific scholarship.
documents: Bank account in the student's name

name: Central Sector Scholarship for College and University Students
ministry: Ministry of Education
summary: Merit scholarship for students who scored well in Class 12 and are going to college.
benefits: Annual scholarship for graduation and post-graduation studies, paid to the student's bank account.
eligibility: Students above the 80th percentile in Class 12 of their board, in regular college courses, with family income within the scheme limit.
documents: Bank account in the student's name

name: PM Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
summary: Free short-term skill training and certification to help young people get jobs.
benefits: Free industry-relevant training, government certificate and placement support.
eligibility: Indian youth, especially school or college dropouts and unemployed people, as per course criteria.

name: e-Shram Card (Unorganised Workers)
ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment
summary: National registration for unorganised workers to get a UAN card and access social security schemes.
benefits: Universal Account Number (e-Shram card), easier access to welfare schemes, and accident insurance support through PMSBY.
eligibility: Unorganised workers aged 16 to 59 who are not EPFO/ESIC members and not income tax payers.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension (NSAP)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
summary: Monthly pension for elderly people from BPL families.
benefits: Monthly pension with a central share plus a state top-up; the total amount varies by state.
eligibility: People aged 60 and above belonging to a BPL household.

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension (NSAP)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
summary: Monthly pension for widows from BPL families.
benefits: Monthly pension with a central share plus a state top-up; the total amount varies by state.
eligibility: Widows aged 40 and above belonging to a BPL household (as per scheme age limits).

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension (NSAP)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
summary: Monthly pension for people with severe or multiple disabilities from BPL families.
benefits: Monthly pension with a central share plus a state top-up; the total amount varies by state.
eligibility: People aged 18 and above with 80% or more disability, belonging to a BPL household.

name: UDID Card (Unique Disability ID)
ministry: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
summary: A single national ID and disability certificate for persons with disabilities.
benefits: One card accepted across India to access disability benefits, concessions and schemes.
eligibility: Any person with a disability as defined under the RPwD Act, 2016.

name: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
summary: Subsidy to install rooftop solar panels at home and cut your electricity bill.
benefits: Central subsidy for rooftop solar (up to Rs 78,000 for systems of 3 kW and above) and up to 300 units of free electricity per month.
eligibility: Households that own a house with a suitable roof and have a valid electricity connection, and have not taken another solar subsidy.
documents: Proof of house ownership / roof rights

name: PM Internship Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Corporate Affairs
summary: 12-month paid internships in India's top companies for young people.
benefits: Monthly stipend of Rs 5,000 for 12 months plus a one-time grant of Rs 6,000, and insurance cover.
eligibility: Youth aged 21 to 24 who are not in full-time education or employment, with family income under the scheme limit. Graduates of premier institutes and some degree holders are excluded.

name: Ration Card under NFSA (Free Foodgrains)
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
summary: Free foodgrains every month for eligible poor households through the ration shop.
benefits: Free foodgrains: 5 kg per person per month for priority households and 35 kg per family per month for Antyodaya (AAY) families.
eligibility: Priority households and Antyodaya families identified by the state government under NFSA.
documents: Aadhaar card of all family members
Passport size photo of head of family

name: PM Kisan Maan-Dhan Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
summary: Voluntary pension scheme for small and marginal farmers.
benefits: Assured pension of Rs 3,000 per month after age 60; government matches your monthly contribution.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers aged 18 to 40 with cultivable land as per state land records.

name: PM Shram Yogi Maan-Dhan (PM-SYM)
ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment
summary: Voluntary pension scheme for low-income unorganised workers.
benefits: Assured pension of Rs 3,000 per month after age 60; government matches your monthly contribution.
eligibility: Unorganised workers aged 18 to 40 with monthly income up to Rs 15,000, not members of EPFO/ESIC/NPS and not income tax payers.

name: MGNREGA (Rural Employment Guarantee)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
summary: Guaranteed paid work for rural households close to home.
benefits: At least 100 days of wage employment per household per financial year, with wages paid to the bank account.
eligibility: Adult members of rural households willing to do unskilled manual work.
documents: Application to Gram Panchayat for job card

name: PM-KUSUM (Solar Pumps for Farmers)
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
summary: Subsidy for farmers to install solar irrigation pumps and solarise existing pumps.
benefits: Central and state subsidy on standalone solar pumps and solarisation of grid-connected pumps; option to sell surplus power.
eligibility: Individual farmers, groups of farmers, cooperatives and panchayats, as per state implementation.
